sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Tahquamenon Falls resources via /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/maps, map 'Rivermouth Modern')

values.note: DNR rate table, Rivermouth Campground: $41 a night with 20/30-amp, $46 with 50-amp. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry (state park campgrounds), on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Tahquamenon Falls / Rivermouth Campground: 50 AMP $46, 20/30 AMP $41), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: midnrreservations.com resources, map 'Rivermouth Modern' (71 sites: 'Electric and Water Hookups: Electric Only' and 'Sewer Hookup: No' on all; 20 sites list 20/30/50 Amps, 51 list 30 Amps) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: DNR lists 72 sites in two wooded loops; the booking site has 71, site lengths 38-100 ft. 25 sites take trailers/RVs up to 50 ft, 6 more to 35 ft, 24 to 30 ft, 7 to 25 ft or less; 5 sites tents/truck campers only. 5 pull-throughs, some paved.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('Number of sites: 72', 'some accessible, paved and pull-though sites') + midnrreservations.com resources (allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to 50'' etc., 'Pull Through: Yes' on 5), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Rivermouth Modern: 'Toilet & shower building', 'Sanitation station', 'Modern campground'; sanitation stations 'open seasonally mid-May to mid-October' with potable water) + DNR rate page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + midnrreservations.com map 'Rivermouth Modern', read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed fees $41 (20/30-amp) to $46 (50-amp) with the Recreation Passport requirement noted; season Apr 15-Oct 14 already manual. Added 50-amp at 20 sites, electric only (no water or sewer at sites, per all 71 booking-site records), 72 sites taking RVs to 50 ft with 5 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/sanitation station/water, reservable. AWH note kept as is.
